test_DatetimeIndex_union: test the DatetimeIndex.union method for combining two datetime indexes with optional sort parameter
test_DatetimeIndex_intersection: test the DatetimeIndex.intersection method for finding common elements between two datetime indexes
test_DatetimeIndex_difference: test the DatetimeIndex.difference method for computing elements in one index but not another
test_DatetimeIndex_symmetric_difference: test the DatetimeIndex.symmetric_difference method for elements in either index but not both
test_timezone_preservation: test that timezone information is preserved when unioning DatetimeIndexes with different time units
test_freq_preservation: test that frequency is preserved in set operations when result is a contiguous subset
